text.en: Find the notes of line 1: each one waits until you're on it.

text.en: Its earliest known printing is in Vocal Melodies of Scotland, in 1841. The tune is probably older than that, and may be older than the words.
text.es: Su primera impresión conocida es de 1841, en Vocal Melodies of Scotland. La melodía probablemente es anterior, y quizá más antigua que la letra.

source.en: Classical-Music.com (BBC Music Magazine's website), "Loch Lomond lyrics" by Jeremy Pound
source.es: Classical-Music.com (el sitio web de BBC Music Magazine), "Loch Lomond lyrics", de Jeremy Pound

text.en: Ralph Vaughan Williams arranged it in 1921 for unaccompanied choir, and his setting has become a famous one.
text.es: Ralph Vaughan Williams la arregló en 1921 para coro sin acompañamiento, y su versión se ha hecho famosa.

text.en: Maxine Sullivan's swing version, recorded in August 1937 to Claude Thornhill's arrangement, was such a hit that it made her famous and led her to swing more folk songs.
text.es: La versión swing de Maxine Sullivan, grabada en agosto de 1937 con arreglo de Claude Thornhill, tuvo tanto éxito que la hizo famosa y la animó a cantar en swing más canciones populares.
